The Corvette ZR1 is quicker to 60 mph than the AWD Corvette E-Ray - How?!
The 2025 Corvette ZR1 has done something remarkable - using just the two rear wheels, it has managed to accelerate to 60 mph quicker than the AWD Corvette E-ray, which at 655 horsepower is no slouch, hitting 60 in 2.7 seconds (2.5 seconds deleting rollout). But the ZR1, sending 1064 horsepower to the rear wheels, manages it in just 2.5 seconds (2.3 seconds deleting rollout). This makes the ZR1 the quickest RWD production car Car and Driver has ever tested (hitting 2.2s w/ rollout in their testing).
